result.stdout:
disc 0.1.2 — a command-line client for any Discourse forum.

Read-first. The only write path is draft creation, which always hands off
to the browser for a human to publish. This tool never publishes directly
and is intended for interactive desktop use (not headless/CI runtime).

Usage:
  disc <command> [options]

Commands:
  context    Manage target forums (add | use | list)
  login      Authorize via the User API Key browser flow (read; --enable-drafts adds write)
  logout     Remove the local credential for the target forum
  whoami     Validate the stored credential and show the user
  status     Show current context, auth state, and scopes
  list       List topics (--top, --category <slug>, --page <n>)
  search     Search topics/posts (--query "<q>", --page <n>)
  read       Read a topic (--topic <id>) or post (--post <id>) [--raw|--cooked]
  categories List postable categories (--all includes read-only)
  draft      Create a draft and open the browser to publish (§ write)
  skill      Generate SKILL.md for the current forum (--output <path>)

Global options:
  --forum <host>     Override the target forum host
  --context <name>   Use a specific named context
  --json             Emit stable machine-readable JSON
  --help, -h         Show help
  --version, -v      Show version

Examples:
  disc context add myforum --host forum.example.com
  disc login
  disc list --top --json
  disc search --query "release notes" --json
  disc categories --json
  disc draft --title "Hello" --category general --body "First post body"
